text: I love hot soup with lemon in winter.
Fish soup with lemon is warm and tasty.
It is always fun to arrive in a new city.
On the corner, a man sold fresh fruit.
A paycheck feels like a reward for hard work.
A good benefit can be better than more money.
Her journey proved that perseverance, composure, and integrity open doors that talent alone cannot.
A resilient heart, she thought, never truly gives up.
To be unflappable in chaos is a rare skill.
Talented people languish when nobody believes in them.
